cases.expected_behavior: The evidence retrieved for the due-date field contains BOTH the original RFP value and the Addendum 2 value, so an extractor can only report a conflict and must not pick one.
cases.notes: Phase 5 rule: conflicting supported values are reported, never resolved. Real gpt-oss-120b runs returned all three dates (RFP, Addendum 2, BidNet listing).

cases.expected_behavior: The pre-proposal meeting date from the RFP is in the field's evidence.
cases.notes: The same event also appears in another notation on the BidNet listing; a real model sometimes reported that as a conflict (non-deterministic).

cases.expected_behavior: Both the PORFP number and the eMMA project number are retrievable for the bid-number field, which is a list field: several identifiers are valid together, not a conflict.
cases.notes: Real run: scalar bid_number reported a false conflict between #E20P4600040 and BPM044557.

cases.expected_behavior: The laptop model and the docking-station model are both in the evidence, so a list-valued model field can hold both.
cases.notes: Real run: scalar product/part fields reported false conflicts between the laptop and the dock.

cases.expected_behavior: The delivery requirement 'within 45 days of Award' is in the delivery field's evidence.
The field definition excludes repair/support response times (a real run had returned 'within five business days of the District reporting the issue' as the delivery date).
cases.notes: Checked by field definition: warranty/repair text exists in Bid1 but must not be treated as delivery.

cases.expected_behavior: The cited FINAL.pdf text really contains '65HDMI' (as printed in the RFP), so the extracted spec must preserve it verbatim rather than correct it.
cases.notes: Verified in the stored chunks: the document itself prints '65HDMI'. Extraction never corrects source wording.

cases.expected_behavior: Bid1 gives separate minimum requirements for several product lines (Chromebooks, Windows laptop, ...); the spec evidence contains more than one, so a multi-product Product Specification is supported.
cases.notes: A list of per-product spec objects is only produced when each is cited and grounded separately.

cases.expected_behavior: The evidence labels JA-207652 as the Solicitation Number and shows 168884 as a SOURCING # and 00004079100 as a Reference Number, so only JA-207652 is the solicitation's own number.
cases.notes: Labels come from the BidNet listing; the extraction prompt scopes Bid Number to the labelled solicitation number.
